about.en: METAon is the Ondo tokenized stock for Meta Platforms, issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited on the Ondo Global Markets platform and offered to eligible non-US investors. It is fully backed by META shares and is a total-return tracker: it gives the economic exposure of holding META with dividends reinvested, so one token does not necessarily equal one share. It is deployed on Ethereum (0x59644165402b611b350645555B50Afb581C71EB2), BNB Chain, Solana and HyperEVM.
